title: 第十章 一户人家第十五章 为什么不开门
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
这是一个五口之家，三代同堂。
主家姓孙，老爷子和老太太都很是硬朗。
如今当家做主的是老爷子的儿子，是个樵夫，这会也是刚刚砍完柴回家。
他妻子在屋内，并未现身见客。
听到孩子的喊声之后，孙家大哥出门将方书文和周青梅迎进了屋内。
方书文自称是赶路人，错过了宿头，看到这里有一户人家，冒昧登门，恳请收留一晚。
一边说，一边取出了银子。
孙家大哥面向憨厚，看到银子连连推拒
“出门在外，马高蹬短的，难免有个不方便的时候。
“小兄弟就不要客气了。
“你们夫妇两个，今天晚上就在咱们这厢房里住一晚吧，银子就不用了。”
他说完也不给方书文拒绝的机会，转身进了屋
“娃他娘，来贵客了，去把后院的鸡抓一只出来宰了好招待客人。”
“知道了。”
女人的声音却满是冷漠。
在孙家大哥的催促下，这才从屋里走了出来。
方书文抬头瞅了一眼，便是眼角微微一跳。
非是这孙家媳妇生的如何好看，而是脸上纵横交错了不少疤痕。
一只眼睛完好，另外一只眼睛却惨白一片，应该是看不见的。
她的手微微颤抖，拿东西的时候也拿不稳，不知道是受了什么伤，走路的时候，左脚拖着右脚，是个跛子。

方书文和周青梅见此对视一眼，都能够看到对方眼神里的诧色。
这苏家媳妇手脚不灵便，在外面折腾半晌，光听到鸡叫和她的惊呼声。
那孙家大哥见此，对方书文和周青梅不好意思的笑了笑，转身出去了。
方书文耳聪目明，便听到在他们面前和颜悦色，一脸老实模样的孙家大哥，一到了后院，就开始怒骂
“你这个贱人，让你做这点事情，你都做不好？
“知道的是让你来杀一只鸡，不知道的还以为你在跟这只鸡生死相搏呢。
“废物，你说说你还能做什么？
“像你这样的，也就是我愿意大发善心要了你，否则的话，出门没三天都得饿死！
“说……你看到这些外面来的人，是不是又想跑了？
“是不是！？”
说到后来，已经不仅仅是怒骂了，好像还动了手。
只是这孙家媳妇始终一语不发。
content_en:
This is a family of five, with three generations living under one roof.
The host's surname is Sun, and both the old man and the old lady are very tough.
The man in charge now is the old man's son, a woodcutter, who has just returned home from cutting firewood.
His wife was in the house and did not appear to see the guests.
After hearing the child's cry, the eldest brother of the Sun family went out and welcomed Fang Shuwen and Zhou Qingmei into the house.
Fang Shuwen claimed to be a traveler and missed Sutou. When he saw a family here, he took the liberty to visit and begged to stay for one night.
As he spoke, he took out the silver.
The eldest brother of the Sun family faced Shanhou and saw Yinzi repeatedly rejecting him.
“When you are away from home and your horse is riding high and its pedals are short, there will inevitably be inconveniences.
“Little brother, don’t be polite.
"You two, please stay in our wing tonight. You won't need any money."
After he finished speaking, he didn't give Fang Shuwen a chance to refuse, and turned around and entered the house.
"Damn it, we have a distinguished guest. Go grab a chicken from the backyard and kill it to entertain the guests."
"Got it."
The woman's voice was full of indifference.
At the urging of the eldest brother of the Sun family, he walked out of the house.
Fang Shuwen raised his head and glanced, then the corners of his eyes twitched slightly.
It's not that the Sun family's daughter-in-law is so good-looking, but that there are many scars crisscrossing her face.
One eye is intact, but the other eye is pale and should be invisible.
Her hands were shaking slightly and she couldn't hold things steadily. She didn't know what kind of injury she suffered. When she walked, her left foot dragged her right foot. She was lame.
Fang Shuwen and Zhou Qingmei looked at each other and could see the surprise in each other's eyes.
The daughter-in-law of the Su family was clumsy in her hands and feet. She was struggling outside for a long time, and all she could hear was the crow of the rooster and her exclamation.
When the eldest brother of the Sun family saw this, Fang Shuwen and Zhou Qingmei smiled sheepishly, turned around and went out.
Fang Shuwen, with his sharp ears and eyes, heard that the eldest brother of the Sun family, who looked kind and honest in front of them, began to curse angrily as soon as he arrived in the backyard.
"You bitch, you can't do this even if I ask you to do it?
“Those who knew it were asking you to kill a chicken, but those who didn’t know thought you were in a life-and-death struggle with the chicken.
"Trash, tell me what else you can do?
"For someone like you, that means I am willing to be kind enough to have you, otherwise, I will starve to death within three days of leaving home!
"Tell me...when you see these people coming from outside, do you want to run away again?
"Isn't it! ? "
Later, he not only cursed angrily, but also seemed to have used his hands.
It's just that the Sun family's daughter-in-law never said a word.
